listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference cited to a companion ENEA methodology paper applied to the Italian cement industry (cement is a listed continuous-production sector), but only as a bibliographic reference, not applied in this study
listed_sector_signals.quote:
From Energy Audit to
Energy Performance Indicators (EnPI): A Methodology to Characterize Productive Sectors. The Italian Cement Industry Case
Study. Energies 2021, 14, 8436.

one_line: The paper defines and validates energy performance benchmark indicators for the Italian private healthcare sector (hospitals) using mandatory energy audit data; its application context is healthcare buildings, not continuous-flow industrial production.
